title: Unit Event — A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call — Episode2 Asahi Genbu

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call
meta.Event Outline: The next ambassadorial performance is going to be the last one?! Wonderlands×Showtime is staggered to hear the news, but is followed by an offer to do a joint performance with a highly regarded theme park that puts on the best shows in Japan. As chaotic practices ensue, Rui is approached by a certain person...

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're here!
Where do you think Miku and the others are!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If they're not here, they're probably at KAITO's tent, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, let's go go go!
I really wanna tell them about our next show♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure they'll want to join in on the action. Miku in particular is probably going to exclaim, “That sounds like fun☆ I wanna be in it too☆”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...?
What's wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was just wondering about something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wondering about what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just how many of my ideas the cast members from ArcLand are going to be willing to accept?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, don't worry.
It's not actually bothering me that much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, after that wedding, the night show and the Sports Festival... I've come to understand that not all are willing to go along with my ideas...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it's okay.
I was simply wondering how far I'll be able to go with our final ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm sure we'll get to do lots!
I mean, your ideas are always super duper fun, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly!! Your directing is invaluable to us!! I say use whatever ideas you see fit!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all very much.
I said NO!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: No, I wanna do it! I'm gonna do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
Those voices...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look over there! It's Miku and everyone!
What are they doing?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, there you all are.
Unfortunately, we have a slight situation on our hands...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What kind of situation?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See the birdie plushie talking to Miku right now? They're arguing about whether or not to do a show on the flying train.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, on the train?
We did that with KAITO once.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's actually the reason.
Our feathery friend here wishes to do the same thing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A show that's full of acrobatic stunts performed on top of the train.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: On top of it? With everyone? That sounds pretty dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
Doing a show like that has certainly crossed my mind before...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I saw before, there's no way to actually operate the train, and it seems to just fly off on its own sometimes. As a result, that endeavor ended up being too risky.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We even thought about how to use wires and such, but couldn't think of what to do if they got tangled up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, we said that we shouldn't do a show up there. But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, it'd be pretty hard to pull off if you can't fly like a birdie. And even the others who can fly said they were scared...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: But I can do it!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I don't care if no one else can! I'll do it by myself!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?!
W-Wait!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As much as they want to do a show, no one else is willing to participate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That sounds like the old me.
I wish I could help out somehow...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We also want to help.
That's why we've been trying to come up with an alternative.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to take up so much of your time with this... You're all here to practice, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, we stopped by to tell you about what we'll be doing for our next show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Please continue.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As it turns out, we're going to be performing a show alongside some cast members from the world-famous theme park, ArcLand.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun!
Do you know what your show is going to be about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not yet. We're scheduled to meet with them tomorrow. Our plan is to discuss ideas with them when we do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Break a leg, everyone!
This should end up being a nice experience for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. We hope so too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Miku's back...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Birdie flew away...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... What do we do? Isn't there a way for us to do a fun show together...? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, when did you guys get here...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We heard about what happened.
How are things going? It sounds like you're in a tough pickle...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I really don't know what to do...
And Birdie flew away all angry and frustrated...
*Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But sighing isn't gonna help us put on a fun show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll keep trying to come up with a way that the plushies can do one...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
Let's work together so that they can put on a good show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please feel free to ask us if you need any help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
As glad as I am that we got to tell them about our next show, it was a bit strange to see them in such a predicament.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it was...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shows can involve a large number of people all fixated on different goals, which can lead to some unpleasant situations.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We'll need to keep that in mind for our own show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Us too?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, because we're gonna be performing with a new set of people. There's probably gonna be some growing pains...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
We just have to get to know each other and...! Oh, I know! We should have some food or snacks together! Then we'll be friends in no time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. What, like eating from the same plate or something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Actually, that may not be a bad idea.
We should do that if we get the chance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's do our best to put on an excellent show together!
Two days later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...!
Soon... No, not yet... But they should be...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This feels like déjà vu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I guess he did the same thing the day before yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I can't wait for them to get here♪
How should we greet them? Oh, what if I flew down from above?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That'd definitely get their attention, but you'd also probably scare them. Let's save that for some other time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let's save it for then!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Alright, it's just about time...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke's Voice
rows.Line: Please enjoy the rest of your visit.
Yes, we intend to!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm! Is that...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm seeing... Seven of them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that person at the front looks really familiar...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-Isn't that Asahi Genbu?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Asahi Genbu...?
Wait, THE Asahi Genbu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Where?! Gen-who?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Genbu. His name's Genbu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi Genbu... He's a young actor who's been attracting quite a bit of attention lately. On top of being a central figure at ArcLand, he's been appearing in movies and TV shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's supposed to be a remarkable actor, so I'm looking forward to seeing how he performs in person.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, he's also famous for being among the first to be asked to perform at the Center Theatre.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The Center Theatre...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, ArcLand has a lot of stages, but you can only perform on that one if you're both young and really good.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ArcLand certainly has been putting a lot of resources into their stage performances recently. They've been recruiting the best up-and-coming actors and directors, while also providing them with an environment in which they can all thrive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd seen Asahi Genbu a number of times before on TV... But to think that he's actually here...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Th-This pregnant pause...!
Wh-What's going on?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, calm down! A star should know how to keep their cool in these situations. Just greet him like normal and...)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's really you!! WXS in the flesh!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Everyone! It's really WXS!
Look, it's Miles! He's literally right in front of us...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Miles?!
O-Oh, from the night show...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: W-Would it be okay if we shook hands?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Of course!! Why not...?!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: C-Calm down, Asahi!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
How can I?!
They're WXS! The ones who came up with that night show!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Haha... I guess there wasn't much we could do to avoid this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-He's way different from what I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He seems really fun and energetic!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh no! I'm sorry, I forgot to introduce myself!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
My name is Asahi Genbu.
I'm beyond ecstatic about being given this opportunity to put on a show with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We're cast members for Tokyo ArcLand's Center Theatre, and we very much look forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, uh...!
We look forward to working with you as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We are Wonderlands×Showtime!
And I am the troupe leader, Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
He's very different compared to when he appears on TV and such...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But he seems like an interesting person.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-I'm Nene Kusanagi...
I started acting when I was little after joining a children's theatre group. One thing led to another and I ended up performing at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Also... I like singing very much!
I-I'm looking forward to working with all of you, and promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, I thought my heart was gonna stop...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was a really wonderhoy speech, Nene! Oh, it might've been more wonderhoy if you sang!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Maybe next time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to introduce ourselves, why don't we start discussing the details for our ambassadorial performance?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Then, can I start?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Since we're gonna be performing at the Museum of Emerging Technologies, what if we did something futuristic?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: F-Futuristic? You always come up with these vague suggestions...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
I think she has the right idea. I mean, we usually try to match these performances to the venue's theme.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right...
As usual, it's best to make the most out of where we'll be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure our audience will also appreciate how it goes with the museum's theme and see it as a special experience.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
So that's how you come up with your ideas for shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We generally try to fully utilize the stage or venue for our performances. Besides that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to make full use of the talent ArcLand has given us.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Asahi Genbu in particular since he's multitalented... He has a knack for quickly getting into character for whatever role he's assigned. Some even call him a genius for being able to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that, but Tsukasa, Nene and Emu stand to learn quite a bit from seeing him perform.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ideally, we'll be able to maximize what we get out of this experience.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Especially for the sake of Tsukasa and Nene, who both dream of seeing the world.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, something that makes use of our venue while also helping improve everybody's skills...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suggest that we do “The Two Androids”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The Two Androids”?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Ah, yes...
That would go well with the museum.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you familiar with “The Two Androids”, Genbu?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's a hidden gem in terms of science-fiction stories. A friend of mine recommended it to me and read it for the first time at a library in Japan when I was in sixth grade.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, what a coincidence.
I read the Yoshio Ueda translation when I was in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You too, Kamishiro?! That's the version I read! But looking back, I had a lot of trouble getting my head around how it was written...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. So did I.
I'm not sure it was meant to be read by elementary schoolers.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Exactly!
I tried reading the original when I was in junior high school and actually had an easier time understanding it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I already had a hunch, but I suppose it's only natural for the young stars of ArcLand to have been exposed to old classics like this one...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But he said “a library in Japan” just now... Does that mean he spent time living abroad for a time?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, what's “The Two Androids” actually about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, about that.
Allow me to give a quick synopsis...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It takes place 100 years in the future in a laboratory where the two androids reside.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They were so new that the professor who made them still hadn't gotten around to programming in any knowledge.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, one day, other humans discover them. Soldiers from Nations A and B.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Both sides sought to weaponize them, which led to each nation taking one android for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With a bit of luck, Alfred, the android that was taken by Nation A, managed to escape the clutches of the military and find refuge in the home of some kind-hearted pioneers at the edge of the wilderness. Alfred would begin learning more about the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Meanwhile, Bartlett, the android that was taken by Nation B, underwent the process of becoming a weapon of war.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! That's terrible!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: But it makes for an interesting story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, during the final scene, they're reunited in the battle-scarred wasteland that was the pioneers' home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One android was taught the value of human kindness, while the other was only shown how to cruelly inflict pain onto others. Despite originating from the same place, they ended up walking down starkly different paths.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What happens next?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What happens next...? Hehe...
You'll just have to read the script to find out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're really not gonna tell us?! You pretty much told us the whole story!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna know too!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Haha! You're quite the storyteller.
But I agree. You should all read what happens for yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, my point exactly.
So, Genbu, promise not to tell them what happens.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Of course!
Oh, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Please, call me Asahi.
If it's okay with all of you, I'd like to call you by your first names as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Asahi, please do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we have our story, let's start choosing roles!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, about that.
I actually have an idea regarding who will be leading...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like you and Asahi to play our two androids, Tsukasa. How does that sound?

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
